claim_boundary: Explicit continuous-motion model with in-route local next-hop decisions and full continuation certificates. No standard winner selected; real network latency, faults and empty trays unsupported.

timing_contract.ebs_storage_dwell: excluded from the sum of separately timed legs

source_order_contract.ordering: Stable raw nominal release-time order per source; ties retain canonical input row order.
source_order_contract.unready_head: An unreleased or EBS-predecessor-blocked head prevents later nominal tasks from attempting.
source_order_contract.first_attempt: Starts only at the actual eligible source-head planning attempt; activation is separate.
source_order_contract.legacy_compatibility: Native activation order retains historical transport behavior;006 static scoring changes observation counters only. Explicit standard mode requires canonical.

pending_performance_criterion.primary: mean user THT per original business bag with all businesses completed
pending_performance_criterion.nanning_priority: improve mean user THT relative to matched HCA
pending_performance_criterion.claim_boundary: The 1.03 tolerance is a provisional root-thread interpretation of the user allowing a small map2 regression; no selected controls or winner is registered.
pending_performance_criterion.system_objective: More completed original businesses in the fixed original window, less backlog, and lower overall mean user THT when the full population completes; canonical elapsed/preplanning and throughput curves required.

source_route_budget_policy.effective: base + rate * elapsed since immutable first planning attempt, growth floors to integer microseconds
source_route_budget_policy.evaluation: only at existing actual source attempts; no new wake event or earliest-admission guarantee
source_route_budget_policy.inroute: the existing finish-nonincreasing fallback rule remains unchanged
source_route_budget_policy.status: candidate controls, not a selected winner

observation_window_extension.purpose: Drain the identical finite cohort; original-window throughput is retained separately.

pressure_signal_policy.scope: node-ranking only; unchanged clocks, FIFO and complete safety certificates
